question: In November 2023, which Indian skydiver jumped from a helicopter from a height of 21,500 feet in front of the world's highest peak Mount Everest?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Shital Mahajan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In November 2023, Shital Mahajan, an Indian skydiver, made a remarkable jump from a helicopter at an altitude of** 21,500 feet in front of Mount Everest.**
 
• Shital Mahajan was born on September 19, 1982, in **Pune, Maharashtra, India**.
 
• In 2004, at the age of 23, Shital Mahajan became the** first woman** to perform a skydiving **jump over both the North Pole and South Pole.**
 
• Shital Mahajan was awarded the** Padma Shri,** one of India's highest civilian honors, in **2011**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• She received the **Tenzing Norgay National Adventure Award**, which is India's highest honor for adventure sports.
 
• Apart from Guinness World Records, her achievements are also recognized by the **Limca Book of Records**, which has featured her for her skydiving feats.
 
• Mount Everest's official height is **8,848.86 meters (29,031.7 feet) **above sea level. This was confirmed by a 2020 survey conducted by China and Nepal.
 
• Everest is part of the Himalayan mountain range, located on the border between **Nepal and the Tibet Autonomous Region of China.**
 
• The** first successful ascent** of Mount Everest was made on May 29, 1953, by **Sir Edmund Hillary of New Zealand **and Tenzing Norgay, a Sherpa of Nepal.
 
• The** youngest person **to summit Everest is **Jordan Romero, who was 13 years old **when he reached the top in 2010.
 
• Everest is still growing at a rate of about **4 millimeters per year** due to tectonic activity between the Indian and Eurasian plates.
